method: The same exported host judgment call with the same synthetic normal-pressure sample, dispatch standing and memory options. Base ignores the new standing option; current refuses a complete selection. Focused controls omit standing as the runner does. Child process exit codes are recorded. This is a deterministic admission comparison, not a live host-memory claim.
